settings.title: System Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure how your community looks, who can join, and how it behaves. Changes apply instantly.

general.title: General
general.desc: Identity and locale for your community.

features.title: Site & features
features.desc: Turn core sections on or off and choose what the homepage shows. Disabling a section hides it everywhere and returns 404 — your data is kept and restored when you re-enable it.

maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance.desc: Take the site offline for everyone except a chosen group. Staff sign in on the maintenance screen to keep working.

login.title: Login
login.desc: How members sign in, and failed-attempt protection.

siteName.label: Site name
siteName.desc: Shown in the header, page titles, and emails.

featuresArticles.label: Articles
featuresArticles.desc: The CMS / blog section. When off, /articles and its API return 404.

featuresHome.label: Home feed
featuresHome.desc: The signed-in home feed at the site root. When off, the root redirects to your landing page.

featuresMembers.label: Members directory
featuresMembers.desc: The public members list. When off, /members returns 404 (profiles stay reachable).

landing.label: Landing page
landing.desc: Where the site root (/) sends visitors. Only enabled sections and installed plugins appear here.

maintenanceEnabled.label: Maintenance mode
maintenanceEnabled.desc: When on, the site shows the maintenance screen to everyone outside the allowed group.

maintenanceAllowedGroup.label: Allowed group
maintenanceAllowedGroup.desc: Members of this group (and administrators) can sign in and use the site during maintenance.

maintenanceTitle.label: Headline
maintenanceTitle.desc: The large heading shown on the maintenance screen.

maintenanceMessage.label: Reason
maintenanceMessage.desc: A short explanation of why the site is down.

maintenanceProgressLabel.label: Progress label
maintenanceProgressLabel.desc: Text shown next to the progress bar (e.g. "Migrating database").

maintenanceProgressPercent.label: Progress %
maintenanceProgressPercent.desc: Progress bar fill (0–100). Set to 0 to hide the bar.

maintenanceEta.label: Back online (ETA)
maintenanceEta.desc: Expected return time. Drives the countdown and the "back online" time. Leave empty to hide.

siteUrl.label: Site URL
siteUrl.desc: The canonical address members reach you at.

siteDescription.label: Site description
siteDescription.desc: A short tagline used for SEO and social cards.

defaultLanguage.label: Default language
defaultLanguage.desc: Used for new members and anonymous visitors.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.desc: Server timezone for timestamps and scheduling.

registrationMode.label: Registration mode
registrationMode.desc: Who is allowed to create an account.

emailVerification.label: Email verification
emailVerification.desc: Require members to confirm their email before posting.

defaultGroup.label: Default user group
defaultGroup.desc: Group assigned to every new member.

allowComments.label: Allow article comments
allowComments.desc: Let members comment on published articles.

approveComments.label: Require comment approval
approveComments.desc: Hold new comments in a queue for a moderator.

perPage.label: Articles per page
perPage.desc: How many articles to show in listings.

showHot.label: Show 'Hot threads'
showHot.desc: Surface trending forum threads in the right rail.

hofRank.label: Hall of Fame ranking
hofRank.desc: The metric the leaderboard is sorted by.

smtpHost.label: SMTP host
smtpHost.desc: The mail server used to send notifications.

fromAddress.label: From address
fromAddress.desc: The sender shown on outgoing mail.

loginMethod.label: Login identifier
loginMethod.desc: Whether members sign in with their email, username, or either.

lockoutEnabled.label: Lock out after failed attempts
lockoutEnabled.desc: Temporarily block sign-in after too many failed attempts from repeated tries.

lockoutMaxAttempts.label: Max failed attempts
lockoutMaxAttempts.desc: Failed attempts allowed before the account is temporarily locked.

lockoutDuration.label: Lockout duration (minutes)
lockoutDuration.desc: How long sign-in stays blocked once the limit is hit.

collectName.label: Collect a name at registration
collectName.desc: Ask new members for a display name (e.g. their full name) shown on their profile.

nameRequired.label: Require the name
nameRequired.desc: Make the name mandatory during registration (only when collecting a name).

showPreviousUsernames.label: Show former usernames
showPreviousUsernames.desc: Display a member’s recent previous usernames on their profile. Members cannot hide this.

previousUsernameDays.label: Former-username window (days)
previousUsernameDays.desc: How long a former username stays visible after a change. 0 = show all history.

invite.title: Invite Codes
invite.subtitle: Generate single-use codes to share with users you want to invite.

beta.modeDesc: When enabled, the site is gated behind beta codes. Staff accounts (admin, supermod, moderator) are always exempt and can log in freely.

beta.codesDesc: Each code is single-use and locks to the IP of whoever redeems it first. No other IP can use the same code.
beta.logDesc: Page visits, logins and blocked access attempts. Auto-refreshes every 15s.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Your installation at a glance — version, stack, live health, and where to get help.

migrations.title: Migration History
migrations.emptyHint: Recorded when the installer applies database migrations or the @nodevo/migrate CLI imports a community from another platform.

NEC-API-4001.desc: The request body, query params, or route params failed Zod validation.
NEC-API-4001.cause: Malformed or missing fields in the request.
NEC-API-4001.fix: Check that all required fields are present and match the expected types.

NEC-API-4003.desc: The authenticated user does not have permission to perform this action.
NEC-API-4003.cause: Missing permission key for the requested resource.
NEC-API-4003.fix: Ensure the user's group has the required permission assigned in ACP → Access Control → Permissions.

NEC-API-4004.desc: The requested resource does not exist.
NEC-API-4004.cause: Invalid ID in the URL, or the resource was deleted.
NEC-API-4004.fix: Verify the resource ID. If recently deleted, this is expected.

NEC-API-4009.desc: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.
NEC-API-4009.cause: The resource was changed by someone else, or the action was already performed (e.g. duplicate create).
NEC-API-4009.fix: Reload the page to get the current state, then retry the action.

NEC-API-4290.desc: Too many requests from this IP or user in the configured time window.
NEC-API-4290.cause: Automated traffic, bots, or a burst of legitimate requests.
NEC-API-4290.fix: Wait for the Retry-After period indicated in the response header, then retry.

NEC-API-5000.desc: An unexpected error occurred on the server.
NEC-API-5000.cause: Unhandled exception in application code. Check the Error Log for a stack trace.
NEC-API-5000.fix: Check ACP → System → Error Log. Report to the maintainer if persistent.

NEC-AUTH-1001.desc: Login failed — no account matched the provided credentials.
NEC-AUTH-1001.fix: Double-check credentials. Use Forgot Password if needed.

NEC-AUTH-1002.desc: The access token has expired and could not be refreshed.
NEC-AUTH-1002.cause: Refresh token expired or was revoked.
NEC-AUTH-1002.fix: Log in again to start a new session.

NEC-AUTH-1003.cause: A moderator or the threshold engine issued a temporary ban.
NEC-AUTH-1003.fix: Wait for the ban to expire, or appeal to a moderator.

NEC-AUTH-1004.cause: A moderator issued a permanent ban.
NEC-AUTH-1004.fix: Contact a site administrator to appeal.

NEC-AUTH-1005.desc: This action requires a verified email address.
NEC-AUTH-1005.cause: The user registered but has not clicked the verification link.
NEC-AUTH-1005.fix: Send a new verification email from Account Settings → Security.

NEC-AUTH-1006.desc: The chosen password does not meet the site's password requirements.
NEC-AUTH-1006.cause: Password is too short or missing required character types.
NEC-AUTH-1006.fix: Choose a password that meets the policy shown in ACP → System → Settings → Auth.

NEC-AUTH-2001.desc: Registration failed — the email address is already registered.
NEC-AUTH-2001.cause: An account with this email already exists.
NEC-AUTH-2001.fix: Use a different email, or log in if this is your account.

NEC-AUTH-2002.desc: Registration or rename failed — the username is already in use.
NEC-AUTH-2002.cause: Another user holds this username, or it appears in username history.

NEC-AUTH-2003.desc: The email verification or password reset token is invalid or has expired.
NEC-AUTH-2003.cause: Token was already used, has expired (15 min for reset, 24 h for verify), or was tampered with.
NEC-AUTH-2003.fix: Request a new email from the relevant form.

NEC-AUTH-1007.desc: The password reset token is invalid, already used, or expired.
NEC-AUTH-1007.cause: Reset links are single-use and expire 15 minutes after being issued.
NEC-AUTH-1007.fix: Request a new reset link from the Forgot Password page.

NEC-PERM-1001.desc: The user lacks the specific permission key required for this action.
NEC-PERM-1001.cause: Group assignment or permission matrix does not include this key.
NEC-PERM-1001.fix: Grant the required permission to the user's group in ACP → Access Control → Permissions.

NEC-PERM-1040.desc: The post or article body exceeds the maximum length for this user's level.
NEC-PERM-1040.cause: Group progression config restricts content length at this level.
NEC-PERM-1040.fix: Shorten the content, or adjust the group's max post length in ACP → Access Control → Groups → Progression.

NEC-PERM-1041.desc: The user has reached their daily post limit.
NEC-PERM-1041.cause: Group progression config sets a daily post cap.
NEC-PERM-1041.fix: Wait until midnight (UTC), or raise the limit in ACP → Access Control → Groups → Progression.

NEC-PERM-1042.desc: Too many attachments on this post.
NEC-PERM-1042.cause: Group progression config restricts attachment count.
NEC-PERM-1042.fix: Reduce attachments, or raise the limit in the group's progression config.

NEC-ARTICLE-3001.desc: The requested article does not exist or has been deleted.
NEC-ARTICLE-3001.cause: Invalid slug or ID, or article was soft-deleted.
NEC-ARTICLE-3001.fix: Verify the URL. If recently deleted, this is expected.

NEC-ARTICLE-3002.desc: The article exists but is not in a published state.
NEC-ARTICLE-3002.cause: Article is a draft or under review.
NEC-ARTICLE-3002.fix: Publish the article from the editor, or check the status in ACP → Content → Articles.

NEC-ARTICLE-3003.desc: The chosen URL slug is already used by another article.
NEC-ARTICLE-3003.cause: Duplicate title or manually set slug.
NEC-ARTICLE-3003.fix: Change the title or set a unique slug in the article editor.

NEC-STORE-7001.desc: The uploaded file exceeds the maximum allowed size for this upload type.
NEC-STORE-7001.cause: File size exceeds the limit defined in UPLOAD_LIMITS config.
NEC-STORE-7001.fix: Compress or resize the file, or increase the limit in the server config.

NEC-STORE-7002.desc: The file type is not allowed for this upload slot or user level.
NEC-STORE-7002.cause: MIME type check failed, or group progression config restricts this type.
NEC-STORE-7002.fix: Use an allowed file type. Admins can adjust group-level type restrictions in Progression config.

NEC-STORE-7003.desc: The file's magic bytes don't match the declared Content-Type.
NEC-STORE-7003.cause: File was renamed to appear as a different type.
NEC-STORE-7003.fix: Upload the correct file. Do not rename files to bypass type checks.

NEC-STORE-7004.desc: The requested storage path is outside the allowed public directories.
NEC-STORE-7004.cause: Attempt to access a private storage path (plugins/, themes/packs/, temp/) directly.
NEC-STORE-7004.fix: Access plugin or style pack files through their authenticated API endpoints.

NEC-PLUGIN-2001.desc: The uploaded plugin package is missing required manifest.json fields.
NEC-PLUGIN-2001.cause: Plugin was built with an outdated SDK or has a malformed manifest.
NEC-PLUGIN-2001.fix: Check manifest.json against the current plugin manifest schema. Required fields: id, name, version, vendor, minNodevoVersion.

NEC-PLUGIN-2002.desc: The uploaded .nvplugin file is not a valid plugin package.
NEC-PLUGIN-2002.cause: Not a ZIP archive, an unsafe (path-traversal) entry, or manifest.json is missing / not valid JSON.
NEC-PLUGIN-2002.fix: Re-download the package from its source. If self-built, rebuild it with the plugin SDK packager.

NEC-PLUGIN-2003.desc: A plugin with this id is already installed on this site.
NEC-PLUGIN-2003.cause: The package was uploaded twice, or an update was attempted through the install flow.
NEC-PLUGIN-2003.fix: Uninstall the existing plugin first, or use the update flow in ACP → Extensions → Installed.

NEC-PLUGIN-2004.desc: An update or management action targeted a plugin that is not installed on this site.
NEC-PLUGIN-2004.cause: The plugin was uninstalled, or the request named the wrong plugin id.
NEC-PLUGIN-2004.fix: Install the plugin first from ACP → Extensions → Marketplace, then retry.

NEC-PLUGIN-2005.desc: The update package version is not newer than the installed version.
NEC-PLUGIN-2005.cause: Updates are forward-only; the package version is the same as or older than what is installed.
NEC-PLUGIN-2005.fix: No action needed — the installed version is already current.

NEC-PLUGIN-2006.desc: Manual .nvplugin uploads are switched off on this site.
NEC-PLUGIN-2006.cause: The marketplace is the sanctioned install channel; manual uploads are off by default.
NEC-PLUGIN-2006.fix: Install from ACP → Extensions → Marketplace, or enable manual uploads on ACP → Extensions → Installed.

NEC-PLUGIN-2010.desc: A plugin migration file contains non-DDL SQL statements.
NEC-PLUGIN-2010.cause: The plugin's migration files include INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/SELECT — only DDL is allowed.
NEC-PLUGIN-2010.fix: Contact the plugin vendor. Migration files must only use CREATE/ALTER/DROP TABLE/INDEX statements.

NEC-PLUGIN-2011.desc: A migration listed in the manifest has no matching .up.sql / .down.sql file in the package.
NEC-PLUGIN-2011.cause: The package was built incompletely — every up migration must ship a matching down migration.
NEC-PLUGIN-2011.fix: Contact the plugin vendor for a correctly packaged build.

NEC-PLUGIN-2012.desc: An already-applied migration file differs from the one recorded at install time.
NEC-PLUGIN-2012.cause: The plugin package ships a modified version of a migration this site already ran.
NEC-PLUGIN-2012.fix: Do not edit applied migrations. The vendor must ship schema changes as a NEW migration in the next version.

NEC-PLUGIN-2013.desc: A plugin migration tries to create, alter, or drop a database object that is either a reserved core object or does not match the plugin's declared table prefix.
NEC-PLUGIN-2013.cause: The migration names an object beginning ncf_, nodevo_, _prisma, pg_, or information_schema, or (when the plugin declares a tablePrefix) an object that omits that prefix.
NEC-PLUGIN-2013.fix: Namespace every table, index, sequence, type, function, and trigger with the plugin's own prefix, and never touch core-owned objects.

NEC-PLUGIN-2020.desc: The requested plugin route is not available.
NEC-PLUGIN-2020.cause: Plugin is installed but currently disabled.
NEC-PLUGIN-2020.fix: Enable the plugin in ACP → Extensions → Installed.

NEC-PLUGIN-2030.desc: The plugin's supported Nodevo version range does not include this platform version.
NEC-PLUGIN-2030.cause: The manifest's minNodevoVersion is newer than this installation, or maxNodevoVersion is older.
NEC-PLUGIN-2030.fix: Update Nodevo, or install a plugin version built for this platform version.

NEC-CORE-8001.desc: The requested theme is not registered in the ThemeRegistry.
NEC-CORE-8001.cause: Theme ID does not match any registered theme.
NEC-CORE-8001.fix: Re-enable the theme or upload its package again.

NEC-CORE-8002.desc: The uploaded .nvstyle package failed validation — the message names the file and rule.
NEC-CORE-8002.cause: Missing manifest.json / styles/light.css / styles/dark.css, or the CSS contains rules beyond :root custom properties.
NEC-CORE-8002.fix: Style packs may only set CSS custom properties on :root. Rebuild the pack; see the theming docs.

NEC-CORE-8010.desc: The site is in maintenance mode and the requester is not in the allowed bypass group. This is an intentional state, not a fault — every blocked request returns this code, so it is NOT written to the Error Log (that would flood it). Enabling/disabling maintenance is recorded in the Activity Log.
NEC-CORE-8010.cause: An admin turned on maintenance mode (ACP → System → Settings → Maintenance). Only the configured allowed group and admins can bypass it.
NEC-CORE-8010.fix: To restore the site, disable maintenance mode in ACP → System → Settings. Staff can sign in on the maintenance screen to bypass it.

NEC-PAGE-3501.desc: The requested custom page does not exist.
NEC-PAGE-3501.cause: The page slug is wrong, or the page was deleted/unpublished.
NEC-PAGE-3501.fix: Check the slug in ACP → Content → Pages, or create the page.

NEC-PAGE-3502.desc: Another page already uses this slug.
NEC-PAGE-3502.cause: Slugs must be unique; the chosen slug collides with an existing page.
NEC-PAGE-3502.fix: Choose a different slug for the page in ACP → Content → Pages.

NEC-QUEUE-5000.desc: A background (BullMQ) job threw an error and failed after exhausting all retries. This is a wrapper code — it tells you a job died, not why.
NEC-QUEUE-5000.cause: The real cause is in THIS Error Log entry's own fields: read the message (e.g. a Prisma/SQL error, a network failure, or a job bug) and the context (queue, jobName, jobId). The NEC code is only the category.
NEC-QUEUE-5000.fix: Open the matching Error Log entry, read its message + context, and fix the underlying cause. Restart the worker process so it picks up the fix; the job re-runs on its next schedule. If the message points to an application bug, report it to the maintainer verbatim.

NEC-QUEUE-5001.desc: A schedule submitted in ACP → System → Scheduled Tasks was rejected.
NEC-QUEUE-5001.cause: The cron expression was malformed, or the schedule would fire more often than the job's minimum interval.
NEC-QUEUE-5001.fix: Use a valid 5-field cron expression, or choose a less frequent interval. The rejected schedule is not saved.

NEC-LICENSE-9001.desc: No valid entitlement exists for this plugin.
NEC-LICENSE-9001.cause: The plugin requires a license but none is activated for this site.
NEC-LICENSE-9001.fix: Activate a license in ACP → Extensions → License, or connect a marketplace account.

NEC-LICENSE-9002.desc: The entitlement is past expiry and the grace period has elapsed.
NEC-LICENSE-9002.cause: The license lapsed and the 30-day offline grace window ended.
NEC-LICENSE-9002.fix: Refresh or renew the license in ACP → Extensions → License. Already-enabled plugins keep running.

NEC-LICENSE-9003.desc: The entitlement is bound to a different domain than this site (production only).
NEC-LICENSE-9003.cause: The site's canonical URL (site.url) host differs from the domain the license was activated for.
NEC-LICENSE-9003.fix: Re-bind the license to this domain, or activate on the correct domain.

NEC-LICENSE-9004.desc: The download gate found no free production activation slot for this purchase.
NEC-LICENSE-9004.cause: All licensed production domains for this purchase are already in use.
NEC-LICENSE-9004.fix: Free a slot, or buy an additional domain on nodevo.io.

NEC-LICENSE-9005.desc: This action needs a connected marketplace account.
NEC-LICENSE-9005.cause: No nodevo.io account is connected for this site.
NEC-LICENSE-9005.fix: Connect an account in ACP → Extensions → Marketplace, or use a manual license key.

NEC-LICENSE-9006.desc: The stored entitlement JWT failed RS256 verification.
NEC-LICENSE-9006.cause: The token was tampered with, or the verifying public key does not match the issuer.
NEC-LICENSE-9006.fix: Re-activate the license. In production, confirm the bundled license public key matches nodevo.io's signing key.

NEC-LICENSE-9007.desc: The marketplace / license server could not be reached.
NEC-LICENSE-9007.cause: Network failure or the license server is down. The 30-day grace period applies.
NEC-LICENSE-9007.fix: Check connectivity. Running plugins are unaffected during the grace window; retry later.

NEC-LICENSE-9008.desc: Activation was refused because this site already has an active license.
NEC-LICENSE-9008.cause: A second key was entered (or account auto-activation ran) while a license is active.
NEC-LICENSE-9008.fix: Deactivate the current license in ACP → Extensions → License first, then activate the new one.

NEC-LICENSE-9009.desc: The license server rejected the request — the message carries the exact reason.
NEC-LICENSE-9009.cause: Unknown or revoked key, ended license term, no free domain slot, or the license is bound to another domain.
NEC-LICENSE-9009.fix: Read the message: renew the term, free/add a domain slot, or contact marketplace support to move the binding.

styleEditor.resetText: Restores the default theme tokens and fonts, and clears your custom CSS for both light and dark. This cannot be undone.
styleEditor.publishHint: Apply staged changes to the live site now
styleEditor.brandingIntro: Upload a logo image or use a text fallback. The site icon is used as the favicon.
styleEditor.logoText: Logo Text (fallback when no image is set)
styleEditor.navbarLogoHint: PNG, SVG or WebP · max 2 MB · recommended 160×40 px
styleEditor.faviconHint: PNG, ICO or SVG · max 2 MB · recommended 64×64 px
styleEditor.cssIntro: Raw CSS for the theme you're viewing — scoped & applied after the tokens so it overrides any rule. Switch your theme with the top-bar toggle to edit the other one. Edits preview live; Apply & Save stores both themes and pushes them to every visitor.
styleEditor.sampleInfo: Info — a background job has started.
styleEditor.sampleError: Error — the server rejected the request.
styleEditor.toastsUse: Toasts use these feedback colours — edits above preview live on the fired samples.
styleEditor.forceState: Force this state on the specimen
styleEditor.previewHint: The specimen with your unsaved edits applied. Click a button, card, field, menu or region to jump to its panel — clicking inside a region preselects that region's scope.

groups.glowDesc: Adds a text-shadow to this group's usernames everywhere on the site.
groups.badgeLabelPlaceholder: Optional — defaults to the group name
groups.name: Name
groups.keyHintCreate: Unique identifier — cannot be changed after creation.
groups.showTeamDescCreate: Members of this group get their own section on the public Members → Team page (ordered by badge precedence).
groups.iconHintCreate: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP · max 512 KB.
groups.keyHintEdit: Key is set at creation and cannot be changed.
groups.showTeamDescEdit: Members of this group get their own section on Members → Team (ordered by badge precedence).
groups.badgeColorHint: Used for the group badge and card accent color.
groups.iconHintEdit: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP · max 512 KB. Shown on group cards and user profiles.
groups.progSub: Configure ladder placement, promotion thresholds and content limits.
groups.onLadderDesc: Users in this group can be auto-promoted
groups.ladderPosHint: Drag to reorder on the Progression page.
groups.deleteText: Members of “{{name}}” will be moved to the Member group.
groups.precedenceTitle: Badge precedence — lower ranks higher. Use the arrows to reorder.
